title: The Bell Has a Pattern
short_role: Choose whether the support warning deserves command attention before the first assault.
setup: The bellkeeper hears a clean Gate signal crossed by a second rhythm from the Workshop lane. The warning can be marked now, or command can remain concentrated at the entrance.

choices.label: Mark the support warning (1 command)
choices.visible_result: The Workshop lane enters the command record, but one intervention is no longer available.

choices.label: Keep command at the Gate
choices.visible_result: Command remains ready for contact; the secondary warning is explicitly left unresolved.
